about_the_game:
In a world where greed surpasses fear, only the cleverest will endure. Design your own dungeon—a lethal snare for anyone who dares to be tempted by your riches. Clever traps, merciless creatures, and complex mazes — all crafted to thwart intruders. Alternatively, take a chance by exploring other players' dungeons, evading deadly traps and claiming their treasures. But remember — death in this world is not final, it's merely another lost opportunity.

Use modules to create intricate labyrinths filled with traps and monsters. Each module has a unique shape, structure, and atmosphere, featuring parkour zones and hidden rooms. Build a dungeon where every step is a risk, every turn is a trap, and anyone who dares to enter becomes a part of your game. But remember – the best dungeon doesn’t just stop intruders. It instills fear in them before they even take their first step.

Venture into dungeons created by other players, use parkour to leap over deadly obstacles and traps, and choose your tactics in intense battles. Every move matters—your survival depends on the precise and timely use of your equipment. Navigate through dangerous corridors, evade lethal mechanisms, and face off against monsters guarding the treasures. But remember—one mistake, and you lose everything: your character and your loot will remain trapped in the catacombs forever.

Mysterious and cunning rogues, charismatic scoundrels, and brilliant tricksters. Tricksters always walk the fine line between life and death, gambling with fate and testing their luck. With the unique ability to inhabit the executed bodies of other tricksters, you can feel alive once more. Take a deep breath and dare to slip into the most treacherous catacombs in pursuit of a tempting and generous reward. Gather your gear and supplies—they will be your key to success in completing the final mission of your new vessel’s existence.

content_descriptors.notes: This game may contain content not appropriate for all ages or for viewing at work
